subject: Pilot readiness & action items — Oceanic AI discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@oceanic.ai>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@oceanic.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot readiness & action items — Oceanic AI discovery follow-up

Hi Samantha / Jordan —

Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Very high level recap below so we’re aligned before we get the pilot scheduled. I tried to capture the key pain points, measurable goals, and what we think makes sense for a minimal initial pilot. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain points (what you shared)
- Search & retrieval is noisy: long-tail queries return outdated content and hallucinations.
- High per-request latency on internal embeddings endpoints during peak hours.
- Cost unpredictability from current vendor when batch sizes spike.

Primary goals for a 6-week pilot
1) Reduce retrieval hallucination rate by 30% on known QA prompt set (baseline: 24% hallucination across 2k test prompts).
2) Achieve median 50–150ms token latency for single-turn generation at 256-token context in your staging region.
3) Demonstrate a 20% per-token cost reduction via batching + KV caching on sample workload.

Proposed pilot scope (minimal viable pilot)
- Model: Redwood-curated open model variant (quantized) matched to your token mix.
- Data: 50k docs (subset) + 10 representative prompt templates from your QA flow.
- Evals: 2 prompt suites (safety/accuracy and relevance), run weekly with automated regression alerts.
- Timeline: Access + infra setup (week 1), ingestion + eval curves (weeks 2–3), tuning + canary traffic (week 4), review & decision (week 6).

Success metrics (to be instrumented)
- Accuracy/hallucination delta on eval set (target: -30% hallucinations).
- Median per-token and tail latency (p50/p95).
- Unit cost per 1k tokens after batching/caching.
- Ops readiness checklist: RBAC, network egress rules, and log forwarding.

Owners / asks
- Oceanic: provide 10 prompt templates, a 5–10MB sample corpus extract, and procurement contact for contract/PO. (Owner: Jordan)
- Redwood: infra setup, model selection, config for batching and KV cache, run initial evals. (Owner: Priyom)
- CS/Onboarding: monitoring dashboard and SLO definition; run weekly syncs. (Owner: Monica)

Access & setup items (actionable)
- Add redwood_pilot@oceanic.ai (we use this for service accounts) to staging bucket with read access.
- Share a short list of IP ranges we'll need whitelisted for the VPC connector.
- Complete the attached pilot scope matrix (oceanic_scope_matrix.xlsx) and return by EOD Friday.

Attachments: oceanic_scope_matrix.xlsx (scope template), redwood_pilot_config.json (example config)

Next steps
- If this lines up, Monica and I will propose a target start date and send a short ops checklist.
- Can we confirm a tentative pilot start week of Nov 30?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites once we lock the date.

--
Priyom Das
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
pri***@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@oceanic.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@oceanic.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness & action items — Oceanic AI discovery follow-up

Thanks, Priyom — this is a great recap. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Hallucination baseline: the 24% number I gave was for downstream QA across our entire corpus; for the pilot subset (50k docs) baseline is ~28%. Fine to use the 28% number as the baseline for the pilot.

2) Latency target: p50 75ms is ideal; p95 we’re flexible up to 300ms during peaks as long as we understand tail behavior.

3) Timeline: Nov 30 start works for us as long as procurement and our infra team confirm whitelisting this week. I’ve looped procurement (procurement@oceanic.ai) — they’ll be the lead on contract timing.

4) Deliverables: I can share the 10 prompt templates and a 7MB sample corpus slice by Thursday. We’ll also provide an engineer contact for network/IP.

Quick note on procurement — Jordan, could you share the PO cadence and any required SOW language?

On the attachments: I reviewed the scope template and will complete the high-level sections; expect it back Friday.

Onward — appreciate the clarity, looking forward to the ops checklist.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Search Products, Oceanic AI
sam***@oceanic.ai | +1 206-555-8842

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@oceanic.ai>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@oceanic.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness & action items — Oceanic AI discovery follow-up

Thanks for the recaps, Priyom and Samantha. Operational TODOs from my side — I’ll own the onboarding checklist and will need the following to get infra queued: 

- Service account (redwood_pilot@oceanic.ai) added with read access to staging bucket (confirm path + object pattern).
- A short sample dataset (S3/gs:// url) and the 10 prompt templates in a single archive (zip preferred).
- Whitelisted IP ranges for our VPC connector (we’ll provide our egress ranges once we know if you prefer static IP or VPC peering).
- Any special compliance needs (PII masking, retention limits) noted here.

I attached a one-page ops_checklist.pdf that maps each item to an owner and ETA. If Oceanic can return items marked in orange by Friday (11/20), we can still start the week of 11/30.

Attachment: ops_checklist.pdf

On monitoring: I’ll prepare a short dashboard template (latency/cost/accuracy) and share it in the hubspot record for the deal. Priyom — can you add the HubSpot link to the follow-up?

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica***@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks all for the quick turn. Confirming actions and owners below (action-by-date style):

- Oceanic (Jordan): share sample dataset URL + completed scope matrix (oceanic_scope_matrix.xlsx) by EOD Friday 11/20.
- Oceanic (Samantha): send the 10 prompt templates and engineer contact for IP whitelisting by Thursday 11/19 COB (you mentioned Thursday in your note; that’s great).
- Procurement (procurement@oceanic.ai): we’ll send a short SOW and quote today; please confirm PO cadence. Link to draft SOW & DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/1234/execute?doc=OCE_PILOT
- Redwood (Monica): ops checklist and dashboard template (ETA 11/20).
- Redwood (Priyom): infra boot & model config; I’ll send a calendar invite for an internal kickoff on Mon 11/30 and an external sync for Tue 12/1.

I’ve created the HubSpot record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/OCE-2026-147 — I’ll add Monica’s dashboard and initial eval results there as they come in.

If everyone is aligned, I’ll circulate calendar invites and the SOW for signature. Thanks again — looking forward to getting this running.
